interpretation: Explicit first-order latent occupancy persistence plus imperfect point detection does not robustly reproduce the complete Tampa state-dimension memory pattern under the frozen grid.
consequence: Three simple response-free sufficiency explanations have now failed under frozen known-truth tests: simple thresholding of a first-order quantitative state, slow latent AR(1) suitability plus fast condition, and first-order latent occupancy persistence with imperfect detection. The empirical Tampa memory contrast remains real as a predictive pattern but its mechanism is unresolved.
hard_stop: Stop response-free mechanism hunting after this v1. Do not retune the latent-occupancy grid or add another simulation family in the same analysis line.
claim_boundary: This is response-free known-truth mechanism evidence, not an ecological replication.
Failure of this model does not prove biological long-memory or identify any alternative mechanism.
Do not retune p11, p01, detectability, tau, support rules, or the grid to rescue this v1 mechanism test.
